title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
summary: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
summary: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
summary: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
summary: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
summary: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
summary: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

title: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
summary: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.
